items.title: Is Southern (SO) Still A Bargain Or Fully Priced On Earnings?
items.summary: Southern Company has rewarded long term holders. With the stock trading around earnings that markets are constantly repricing, the key issue is whether today’s valuation still lines up with what the utility is actually earning. Over the past 5 years, Southern has delivered a 77.2% total return, which puts real weight on the question of how much earnings power is now already reflected in the share price.
